@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Mr. Wang took a business trip to Japan and came back with some s______rs for his family.
= souvenirs
~詞義 souvenir（n.）紀念品
~原文 Mr. Wang took a business trip to Japan and came back with some souvenirs for his family.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tracy has been d______ed with breast cancer, but her doctor says that she will likely recover.
= diagnosed
~詞義 diagnose（v.）診斷
~原文 Tracy has been diagnosed with breast cancer, but her doctor says that she will likely recover.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The detective questioned everyone to uncover the true m______e for the murder.
= motive
~詞義 motive（n.）動機
~原文 The detective questioned everyone to uncover the true motive for the murder.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: My sister is a college s______e. She will become a junior next year.
= sophomore
~詞義 sophomore（n.）(大學、高中)二年級生
~原文 My sister is a college sophomore. She will become a junior next year.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The voting process will be a______s, so you will be free to make whatever decision you want.
= anonymous
~詞義 anonymous（adj.）匿名的
~原文 The voting process will be anonymous, so you will be free to make whatever decision you want.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The secret ingredient in this recipe is ______. It adds a fresh flavor to the soup.
A: analyst
B: diaper
C: entity
D: vinegar
= D
~詞義 vinegar（n.）醋
~原文 The secret ingredient in this recipe is vinegar. It adds a fresh flavor to the soup.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Alan's new apartment is bright and ______. It has much more room for his cat to play in.
A: crude
B: profound
C: prone
D: spacious
= D
~詞義 spacious（adj.）寬敞的
~原文 Alan's new apartment is bright and spacious. It has much more room for his cat to play in.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Though Cindy and I share different ______ regarding politics, we are still very good friends.
A: premiums
B: molecules
C: projections
D: viewpoints
= D
~詞義 viewpoint（n.）觀點
~原文 Though Cindy and I share different viewpoints regarding politics, we are still very good friends.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Tina sets her alarm clock to ring at five-minute ______ so that she won't fall back to sleep and be late.
A: diameters
B: intervals
C: propagandas
D: volcanos
= B
~詞義 interval（n.）間隔
~原文 Tina sets her alarm clock to ring at five-minute intervals so that she won't fall back to sleep and be late.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The strict coach demands absolute ______ from his players. They must obey his orders.
A: compliance
B: complication
C: integration
D: sovereignty
= A
~詞義 compliance（n.）服從
~原文 The strict coach demands absolute compliance from his players. They must obey his orders.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: booth
B: integrates
C: mortgage
D: intensified
E: visa
F: sophisticated

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ms. Smith ______ games into her English lessons, and her students really enjoy learning the language with her.
= B
~詞義 integrate（v.）使融入
~原文 Ms. Smith integrates games into her English lessons, and her students really enjoy learning the language with her.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. Lin decided to place a(n) ______ on his house to overcome his financial difficulties.
= C
~詞義 mortgage（n.）將…拿去抵押貸款(place a mortgage on)
~原文 Mr. Lin decided to place a(n) mortgage on his house to overcome his financial difficulties.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ken's friends consider him a(n) ______ person, though he is in fact younger than most of them.
= F
~詞義 sophisticated（adj.）世故的
~原文 Ken's friends consider him a(n) sophisticated person, though he is in fact younger than most of them.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Alice has to apply for a work ______ after she graduates from college, or else she will have to leave this country.
= E
~詞義 visa（n.）簽證
~原文 Alice has to apply for a work visa after she graduates from college, or else she will have to leave this country.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Maggie's disrespectful attitude ______ her mother's anger. In the end, she was grounded for a week.
= D
~詞義 intensify（v.）強化
~原文 Maggie's disrespectful attitude intensified her mother's anger. In the end, she was grounded for a week.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: anticipate
B: toll
C: progressive
D: cruise
E: freighted
F: fraud

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The tennis player can return his opponent's shots very accurately; it seems that he can ______ his opponent's every move.
= A
~詞義 anticipate（v.）預期
~原文 The tennis player can return his opponent's shots very accurately; it seems that he can anticipate his opponent's every move.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: These strawberries were ______ by air from Japan to Taiwan in order to retain their freshness.
= E
~詞義 freight（v.）運送(貨物)
~原文 These strawberries were freighted by air from Japan to Taiwan in order to retain their freshness.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: My grandmother is suffering from a(n) ______ loss of eyesight. She will be completely blind in a few years' time.
= C
~詞義 progressive（adj.）漸進的
~原文 My grandmother is suffering from a(n) progressive loss of eyesight. She will be completely blind in a few years' time.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The alert bank clerk prevented the old man from losing money to Internet ______.
= F
~詞義 fraud（n.）詐騙
~原文 The alert bank clerk prevented the old man from losing money to Internet fraud.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Years of poor sleep took a heavy ______ on Sam's health, so he felt exhausted and unfocused very often.
= B
~詞義 toll（n.）對…造成嚴重損害(take a heavy toll on)
~原文 Years of poor sleep took a heavy toll on Sam's health, so he felt exhausted and unfocused very often.
